programmes.show_name: Lex and Plu Space Taxi Drivers
programmes.show_description: Upholding the Law: Greg decides to get his driver's license. Lex and Plu laugh at their friend, thinking he'll never manage to get a handle on it. But Greg surprises everyone!
Favourite Thing: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game.
Daddy Dropoff: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.
Unicorse: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, who Bluey tries to reform.
Curry Quest: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.
Turtles Hide Fast: After a turtle encounter, Fuzzy Yellow's friends gather for the Feast of Favourite Fruits. But Fuzzy Yellow's grapes go missing. (SL)
